description: This header file defines the interface for managing transactions within the OvsAgent component, including functions for initializing, creating, updating, deleting, and completing transactions, as well as associated callback mechanisms and data structures.

methods.name: init_transaction_manager
methods.description: Initializes and allocates resources for the transaction manager, setting up internal data structures.

methods.name: deinit_transaction_manager
methods.description: Deallocates resources and cleans up the transaction manager.

methods.name: insert_transaction
methods.description: Creates and adds a new transaction entry with a unique request ID, callback, and configuration.

methods.name: delete_transaction
methods.description: Removes a transaction entry identified by request ID and frees its resources.

methods.name: update_transaction
methods.description: Updates an existing transaction with a new UUID.

methods.name: complete_transaction
methods.description: Marks a transaction as completed, invoking its callback, and freeing associated resources.
